title: RWB-S8-E2029-APP: the confirmed-proposal raise has no published request shape beyond the legacy Java signature, no operation name for the agent-policy read, no published constraint for one open code, no envelope type for the decision-record entry and no test level
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2, R7.3 and R9; context pack S8 rwb-deviation; split plan story line RWB-S8-E2029-APP; legacy RWB-E2-029; FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A2.1, A2.2, A2.5, A2.7 and A2.8; TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T7, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 8 and 13
section: Metadata (Depends on (build), Contract dependencies, Patterns applied); Sections 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12.1 to 12.9, 13, 14 and 16
description: (1) Legacy section 12 publishes a Java interface raise(caseId, deviationCode, reason, documentIds, raisedBy, agentRunId), while the required column deviation.paused_state (DF-CAS-041) needs the return point, the decision record needs the agent version that legacy AC4 prints as SCREENING@P2/PR2, and the mode gate needs the policy segment pair, so the REST request carries three fields the legacy signature does not name. (2) No source publishes the operation name or the field names of the agent-policy read the gate needs, nor a message id for a gate refusal no person sees. (3) No source publishes a constraint or a key that makes legacy AC8 true, that two simultaneous confirmations of one code leave one deviation and one event. (4) The envelope type of the decision-record entry on the shared topic rwb.decision-record.v1 is the library's and is not printed by any source read for this slice. (5) The pattern set carries DP-03, DP-06, DP-07, DP-09 and DP-19, whose DP table rows add five platform H dependencies, while the plan's H row for this secondary slice is empty and its C row holds the contract of the key. (6) The twelve legacy test cases carry no level, and the agent half of each is RWB-P10-E2029-APP's. (7) Legacy AC2 asserts that the case status becomes On hold, which no source assigns to a service: it is a reaction to the event and not a write of this slice.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-029 section 4 steps 6 and 7, section 12 (Java interface and the two write operations), section 7 AC2, AC7, AC8, AC9, section 11 (DF-AGT-038, DF-AGT-059, DF-AGT-060, DF-CAS-037 to DF-CAS-043), section 16 (no level column); FSD S8 A2.7.4 and A2.8.3.2 (deviation.paused_state required); TSD S8 T3.1 (paused_state Required Yes), T3.2, T-A.1 and T-A.2 (errors and Idempotency-Key); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 and R7.2 section 16
proposed: Publish the raise request on the contract of RWB-P10-E2029-CON with the added fields; name the agent-policy read; add the partial unique index of one open code per case; publish the envelope type of the decision-record entry; assign a level to every legacy case in the Test Cases workbook
